title: Form
description: A form as a whole, as a client draws and sends it: its fields in the order they are shown, each one of the field schemas beside this file, and where and how it is sent. A field's `name` is its own; a server reading forms under a name — Symfony's `form[field]` — composes the full name from the form's. The token, when the server asks for one, is sent as a field would be. What the server answers is form_submit_response.json.

name.description: The form's name, under which its fields are sent: `form[field]`. Empty, the fields are sent by their own names.

token.description: What the server asks to be sent back, against forgery: sent as a field named so.
